key_insight: Reinforcement learning guides adaptive grid refinement for the Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman equation, concentrating nodes where discretization error is large to support optimal feedback control.
engineering_relevance: Error-focused refinement could make feedback-control computation more resource-efficient than using a uniformly fine state-space grid.
method: Solve the HJB equation on a state-space grid.
Use an RL-based approach to adapt grid-node placement.
Target fewer total nodes while increasing density in high-error regions.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes the approach and its intended efficiency and accuracy benefits but reports no benchmarks, quantitative results, or evaluation details.
watch_item: Scalability and accuracy gains remain unverified in the abstract, especially for high-dimensional state spaces.
paper_title: Adaptive Grid Refinement for Optimal Feedback Control
